about: What pairtime knows about an executable, shared by the Windows, macOS and Linux code. app_class is the os.focus class of a window the executable owns (SM 1.2, 2.5, 3.2). role is its part in a parent chain, which decides a harness session's parent_class (SM 1.2, 2.2 rule 4). Names are lowercase executable base names without .exe; a trailing * matches any rest. appclass.go documents every field, and appclass_test.go checks every entry.
